caption: Cutting the listing at the leaders 1, 2, 4 and 7 gives four blocks. B2 tests t1 = 4 × i > 100, B3 runs the body 25 times and jumps back, so B2 → B3 → B2 is the loop and B2 is its test.

spec.aria: A flow graph of four basic blocks: B1 (statement 1) falls into B2 (statements 2 to 3), B2 tests t1 = 4 × i and goes to B3 (statements 4 to 6) while t1 is at most 100 or leaves to B4 (statement 7) when t1 is above 100, and B3 jumps back to B2 to close the loop.
